name: Animate Wood
body:
School transmutation [wood]; Level druid 1, shaman

Casting Time 1 round

Components V, S, M (a splinter)

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target one small log or pile of wood

Duration 1 round/level (D)

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

Wood: Spells with this descriptor include those that directly create, utilize, or manipulate plant or wood in some manner or conjure creatures with the plant subtype or composed of wood. Such spells are considered to belong to the Wood element (for geomancers) and the Wood elemental school (for wood elementalists).

You animate a small batch of wood the size of a small creature. For the duration, the animated wood has the statistics of a small animated object with a hardness of 5. This spell cannot be cast on wood objects carried or worn by another creature. At the end of the duration, the animated wood returns to its original form in its new square. The animated wood cannot move beyond the range of the spell from the caster.
